claim: 제3국을 지나면 국내 수송이 아닙니다. 제35조(2)가 적용됩니다.
evidence: Commentary, not translation. Art 35(2) covers only waste destined for recovery transiting third countries to which the OECD Decision applies: 'Where a shipment is carried out within the Union, including a shipment between localities in the same Member State, and transits through one or more third countries to which the OECD Decision applies, and the waste is destined for recovery, Articles 4 to 30 shall apply...'. Disposal waste falls under Art 34, and recovery waste transiting non-OECD-Decision countries under Art 35(1) (which refers to Art 34).
fix: 제3국을 지나면 국내 수송이 아닙니다. 제34조 또는 제35조가 적용됩니다(같은 회원국 안 두 지점 사이의 운송을 명시한 것은 회수 목적 폐기물이 OECD 결정 적용 제3국을 지나는 경우의 제35조(2)).

evidence: Art 36(1)-(2) translation checked in full (translation correct); commentary cross-references to Arts 33, 35 checked. 2 provisions + commentary checked, 1 problem (commentary only, no translation error)
